accessDenied.title: No branding access

header.title: Brand & branches
header.subtitle: Your look for {restaurant} — logo, app icon and colors — plus the branches that use it.

loyalty.title: Loyalty pool
loyalty.description: Choose whether loyalty points are shared across all branches (default) or scoped to one branch.

modeHints.brand: Points pool across all branches of this restaurant.
modeHints.branch: Points are earned and redeemed within a single branch.

storefront.title: Storefront appearance
storefront.description: How the menu looks to customers. Applies to every branch of this restaurant.
storefront.heroTitleHint: Leave empty to use the default headline.
storefront.heroSubtitleHint: Leave empty to show “Now serving from '{branch}'”.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Locations under {restaurant}. Each gets its own storefront URL + QR code.
branches.seatsUsed: You are using {used} of {seats, plural, one {# branch seat} other {# branch seats}}. Add a seat to open another location — it gets the full feature set of your main branch.
branches.copyNote: A new branch can copy the menu, opening hours and payment settings of an existing one. Its map pin and table QR codes are never copied — set those in the new branch’s settings.

brandList.empty: No brand yet. Upload your logo under <link>Branch settings → Branding</link> and it is created for you.

copy.menuHint: Categories, items and their option groups
copy.hoursHint: The weekly hours, not one-off closures
copy.settingsHint: Payment methods, delivery, tips and service fee
copy.notCopied: Address, map pin, colours and table QR codes are not copied.

errors.seats: {limit, plural, one {You are using your only branch seat.} other {You are using all # of your branch seats.}} Add a seat (+$99/mo) on the Plan page, then create the branch.
errors.inactive: Your subscription is not active. Choose a package on the Plan page to continue.
errors.notAuthorized: Only the owner or an admin can add a branch.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a branch name and a URL slug.
errors.slugTaken: Another branch already uses that URL slug. Choose a different one.
errors.noBranchId: The branch was created, but the reply did not say which branch it was, so nothing was copied into it. Close this and set the branch up in its own settings.
errors.copyMenuNotEmpty: The branch was created, but copying from {source} failed: the new branch already has menu items. Untick “Copy menu” and retry to copy the rest, or close this and set the branch up in its own settings.
errors.copyFailed: The branch was created, but copying from {source} failed. You can retry the copy, or close this and set the branch up in its own settings.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

created.copiedFromUnknown: Copied into {name} from the source branch:

created.hours: {count, plural, one {# opening-hours window} other {# opening-hours windows}}
created.settingsCopied: Payment, delivery, tip and service fee settings
created.settingsNone: No payment or delivery settings: the source branch has none saved
created.todo: Still to do at the new branch: drop its map pin and set up its table QR codes. Those are never copied.
